verdict.rationale: A shared team knowledge workspace is a fair question for a coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents creating a shared workspace from docs and repos as a team source of truth. Skills, MCP data sources and the Kanban board are related features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
